[[Category:Killycurragh Townland, Derryloran Parish, County Tyrone]]
== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
James was born about 1833. His father was named David Glasgow, and James lived at Killycurragh, Derryloran as of his marriage in 1855.

On 9 Jan 1855 at Oritor Presbyterian, James(age 22) married Hannah Ferguson(19) of Killycurragh, daughter of Robert Ferguson, farmer. Witnessed by William Glasgow and James Ferguson.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/e663a73250139 James Glasgow / Hanah Ferguson , 1855, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Marriages</ref>

He passed away 12 Feb 1897 at Killycurragh age 63 due to diabetes, attended by Hannah Glasgow, widow, Killycurragh.
<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/f9e14f4169091 James Glasgow, 1897, 63, Cookstown] at Irish Civil Registration - Deaths</ref>
He was interred at Clare. The chief mourners were:
<ref>[https://www.britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk/viewer/bl/0002006/18970220/048/0003 "Funeral of Mr James Glasgow, Killycurragh"], ''Mid-Ulster Mail'' - Saturday 20 February 1897, Page 3</ref>
* James Glasgow, Henry Glasgow, Thomas Glasgow, George Glasgow (sons)
* [[Glasgow-1706|John Glasgow]], David Glasgow (brothers)
